exams.action: Collect and bind: historical prompt/export/tool trace explicitly naming the agent or provider; or an authenticated execution/audit log linked by timestamp and artifact fingerprint

exams.failure_condition: Missing source identity, substituted historical object, unsupported inference or failed reproduction.

exams.trigger: Before making a protected-branch enforcement claim.
exams.action: Read active rulesets and required checks for main; separately decide enforcement under repository authority.
exams.evidence_out: Dated provider readback and a denied merge control, if enforcement is configured.
exams.closure_gate: Provider reports active enforcement and a required-check failure demonstrably blocks promotion.
exams.failure_condition: Workflow exists but protection is absent, inactive or bypassed.

exams.trigger: When this legacy application is selected as an authorized build target.
exams.action: Resolve the observed Dart 3.1.0 versus yaml >=3.1.3 (Dart >=3.4.0) constraint in an isolated application change; then build and record the APK result.
exams.evidence_out: Dependency resolution log, build log and artifact digest tied to the same commit; device receipt separately.
exams.closure_gate: Dependency resolution and requested build pass on the exact source commit.
exams.failure_condition: pub get failure, skipped build or artifact absent; source audit success does not close this gap.

exams.trigger: After a pipeline change is submitted for review.
exams.action: Bind the Omega Actions run, requested SHA, checked-out SHA, seven gate results, negative controls and artifact digest.
exams.evidence_out: Downloaded receipt bundle plus provider run/artifact metadata on the exact reviewed commit.
exams.closure_gate: Tests and seven audit gates pass; negative tests reject false promotion; bundle digests verify.
exams.failure_condition: Missing, stale, cancelled or skipped gate; source mismatch or unavailable artifact.

exams.trigger: After a scoped local/CI receipt is available.
exams.action: Repeat the same source snapshot and commands on an independently identified environment; compare semantic outputs.
exams.evidence_out: Independent environment identity, source hashes, commands, result and effective-state digest.
exams.closure_gate: Independent run agrees on invariant outputs or records a reproducible contradiction.
exams.failure_condition: Same-run copy treated as independence or differing inputs without a declared transformation.
